answer: In garment-trade agent economies, each workshop stakes a ferrous token bonded to its physical sewing floor, forming a vine of verified provenance that new agents must graft onto before bidding. A voyage ledger records every inter-workshop shipment, so identity reuse across two nodes collides on the same bonded route and is flagged instantly. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
